summary.text: Cara Cody-Braun is an independent candidate for the North Dakota House of Representatives, District 11, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a retired teacher who said in a Ballotpedia survey that keeping state funding in North Dakota public schools is one of her key issues.

paragraphs.text: Cody-Braun graduated from Mandan High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Moorhead State University in 1989 and a graduate degree from North Dakota State University in 2019, according to Ballotpedia.
Ballotpedia describes her as a retired teacher.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Cody-Braun said she supports early childhood and public education and wants North Dakota to focus on childcare, early childhood education and public schools to keep and attract families.
She said she wants to protect the state's natural resources and to add a variety of voices to balance what she called a lopsided balance of power in the state.
She listed education, environment, human rights and housing as policy areas she cares about, and named ND Dem-NPL District 11 and Planned Parenthood as endorsers.
